evidence_table.claim: Engineered Components sales were USD1.835bn and segment adjusted operating income USD303m, versus USD1.710bn and USD267m.
Intelligent Systems sales were USD1.402bn and segment adjusted operating income USD124m, versus USD1.442bn and USD137m.
Sensors and Compute revenue fell to USD1.299bn from USD1.325bn and Software and Services to USD119m from USD134m.
Versigent began trading on 1 April 2026 and historical EDS results are discontinued operations.
evidence_table.result: verified; no discontinued revenue is mixed into continuing segment comparisons

evidence_table.claim: Cash fell to USD670m, long-term debt to USD5.332bn, and spin-related cash flows included a USD1.893bn distribution, USD2.054bn note repayment and USD282m cash transfer.
